info.title: TerraBase Client HTTP API
info.description: Initial v1 HTTPS/JSON document API for a provisioned document shard (local-v1 or signed-v2 as configured). Use the same HTTPS origin that serves this specification. A scoped key is entered only in the browser authorization field or client process; no credential is included here. The collection schema and digest are provisioned through the operator path, not through these document routes. The active server configuration controls durability and retry limits. Document writes use transaction commits, reads use point reads, and scalar filters use the paginated query route; there are no separate PUT, PATCH or DELETE routes. Commit examples are refreshed with a ten-minute expiry when this document is served; reload the reference if the example has expired. Replace the example schema digest with the one provisioned for your collection.

externalDocs.description: Separate gRPC, SQL and local operator boundaries

servers.description: Same HTTPS origin as this document; direct requests with no third-party proxy.

get.description: Requires a scoped API key with read permission for this tenant, database, shard, and collection. A missing document returns 200 with state absent. A tombstone returns state deleted. The read may show concurrent siblings and a causal context to pass to a subsequent write. Responses are bounded to 4 MiB. No query string or request body is accepted.

parameters.name: shard
parameters.description: Shard number in canonical unsigned decimal.

503.description: Capacity/admission, storage, corruption or uncertain commit failure. Retry commit_uncertain only with the same transaction identity and body after recovery.

post.description: Requires read permission for the exact tenant, database, shard, and path collection. The strict scalar predicate and limit are fixed for every page. The first response captures a stable snapshot; use next_cursor with the identical predicate and limit to continue. Each continuation reauthenticates the current key. Cursors expire after 60 seconds and bind the path scope, query, schema, and key identity. A process restart or another member invalidates the cursor; start the query again. Request and response JSON are limited to 4 MiB. Content-Type must be exactly application/json, with no content encoding or query string.

parameters.name: shard
parameters.description: Shard number in canonical unsigned decimal.

requestBody.description: One typed scalar predicate. Field paths contain 1 through 16 numeric field IDs. The page limit is 1 through 128. Do not change the predicate or limit when continuing a cursor.

200.description: One ordered page from a fixed document snapshot.

400.description: Malformed query, invalid cursor, or expired cursor.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or otherwise unauthorized API key.

403.description: The current key does not grant this collection scope.

429.description: The key exceeded its rate or concurrency limit.

503.description: The bounded worker, memory admission, or document store is unavailable.

post.description: Requires the current scoped collection Read grant on every finite snapshot or poll request. Snapshot pages use one applied native cut; continue with next_snapshot_cursor and the same predicate and limit until the terminal page supplies poll_cursor. Poll returns ordered complete native groups, including empty effects for unrelated or SQL-only changes. A null point removes a former match. Cursors expire after 60 seconds, are process-local and bound to the path, predicate, schema, and current credential. An expired cursor, changed schema, expired history, or an oversized first group returns 409 resync_required; start a new snapshot. A tampered or cross-route cursor returns 400 invalid_cursor; restart or member move also requires a fresh snapshot. During a storage hold the server returns 503 without advancing a cursor. Bodies and responses are bounded to 4 MiB; Content-Type must be exactly application/json and URL query strings are forbidden.

parameters.name: shard
parameters.description: Shard number in canonical unsigned decimal.

requestBody.description: Exactly one version-one snapshot or poll shape. Snapshot limit is 1 through 128 and is fixed across pages; poll repeats the predicate but has no limit.

200.description: One fixed-cut snapshot page or a bounded poll of complete native groups.

400.description: Invalid request shape or malformed, tampered, or context-mismatched cursor. A restart or member move invalidates the process-local cursor; begin a new snapshot.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked, or otherwise unauthorized API key.

403.description: The current key does not grant this collection scope.

429.description: The key exceeded its rate or concurrency limit.

503.description: Storage is unavailable or held, or bounded worker capacity is exhausted. No advancing cursor is issued.

409.description: Authenticated cursor expired, schema changed, history expired, or first complete group exceeded the response bound. Begin a new snapshot.

post.description: Requires write permission for every collection in writes. A live write creates or updates a document; a tombstone deletes it. Writes are sorted by (collection, document), and field IDs are sorted within each object. Use the current point context as observed for updates/deletes. Identical retries with the same transaction ID and body return the original result without another effect. Reusing an ID for different content yields 409. An expired ID yields 409. A 503 commit_uncertain requires retrying the identical request and ID after recovery; do not create a fresh transaction to infer the first failed. The active durability profile decides whether the 200 receipt is local_durable or object_durable. Request and response JSON are limited to 4 MiB. Content-Type must be exactly application/json, with no content encoding or query string.

parameters.name: shard
parameters.description: Shard number in canonical unsigned decimal.

requestBody.description: Use actual provisioned schema and current state_version/context for updates/deletes. Recompute effect_digest after changing scope, authority, conditions, observed or values. Transaction expiry/nonce are excluded from the digest.

create.summary: Create a document (replace digest, expiry and nonce); recompute effect_digest after replacing scope/schema/condition/value

delete.summary: Delete after reading current context (replace digest, expiry, nonce and observed); recompute effect_digest after replacing scope/schema/condition/value

update.summary: Update after reading current context (replace digest, expiry and nonce); recompute effect_digest after replacing scope/schema/condition/value

503.description: authority_unavailable, commit_uncertain, storage_unavailable, or capacity; no definitive abort is implied

409.description: Schema changed or the idempotency token was reused with different content or expired.

412.description: precondition_failed; no document writes from the rejected group

x-codeSamples.label: Create with fresh retry identity
x-codeSamples.source:
# Set TB_API_URL, TB_TOKEN, TB_TENANT, TB_DATABASE, TB_SHARD,
# TB_COLLECTION, TB_DOCUMENT and the provisioned TB_SCHEMA_DIGEST.
TB_EXPIRY_MS=$(($(date +%s) * 1000 + 600000))
TB_NONCE=$(openssl rand -hex 16)
TB_BODY=$(jq -nc --arg expiry "$TB_EXPIRY_MS" --arg nonce "$TB_NONCE" \
  --arg collection "$TB_COLLECTION" --arg document "$TB_DOCUMENT" \
  --arg digest "$TB_SCHEMA_DIGEST" \
  '{version:1,transaction_id:{expires_at_unix_ms:$expiry,nonce:$nonce},writes:[{collection:$collection,document:$document,schema_generation:"1",schema_digest:$digest,observed:[],value:{kind:"live",fields:[{id:1,value:{type:"utf8",value:"first note"}}]}}]}')
curl --fail-with-body -sS -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TB_TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --data-binary "$TB_BODY" \
  "$TB_API_URL/v1/tenants/$TB_TENANT/databases/$TB_DATABASE/shards/$TB_SHARD/transactions"

scopedApiKey.description: Use a provisioned, scoped tbk1 API key. Read and write grants are checked for the exact tenant/database/shard and collection. Do not put the key in a URL.

DecimalU64.description: Unsigned decimal integer represented as a string so JavaScript does not round 64-bit values.

PositiveDecimalU64.description: Positive unsigned decimal integer represented as a string.

TransactionId.description: Expiry must be later than server time and within the configured retry window (24 hours in the current default profile). Generate a fresh random nonce for each new logical transaction; reuse both fields only for an exact retry.

FieldValue.description: Tagged document value. Nesting is limited to 16 levels and 4096 total value nodes.

Field.description: Field IDs in each field array must be unique and strictly increasing.

Write.description: Sorted strictly by (collection, document). Explicit conditions and the whole same-shard group are evaluated under native storage commit exclusion. observed is causal context, independently of condition.

CommitRequest.description: One atomic same-shard transaction, maximum 4 MiB raw JSON. SHA256 effect_digest uses TB-DOC-EFFECT-v1 normalized binary scope/authority/write grammar, excluding transaction_id. Exact retries preserve original committed and rejected outcomes until expiry; changed effects conflict before conditions are reevaluated.

value.description: UTF-8 text bounded to 1 MiB of encoded value bytes and the 4 MiB request limit.

QueryRequest.description: The body is limited to 4 MiB. Cursor tokens are opaque and valid for 60 seconds.

QueryResponse.description: Rows are ordered by canonical document ID. Each point contains complete causal state, including all visible conflict siblings.

Sibling.description: fields exists only for live siblings.

state_version.description: Exact authority/schema-bound state token for one live/deleted sibling. Absent/conflict return null.

PointResponse.description: Absent is HTTP 200 with empty context and siblings. A deleted point contains its tombstone. Concurrent live siblings may produce conflict; use context as observed for a resolving write.

CommitResponse.description: A local_durable receipt only covers the local synced SSD. object_durable is emitted only after the configured object publication/readback barrier. The commit sequence is the local durable frontier, not a replication-applied frontier.

Error.description: Errors expose a stable code and do not echo API keys or request payloads.

MutationAuthority.description: Exact mutation authority. single_writer fails authority_unavailable until a durable security writer fence is installed; membership authority is not a security writer fence.

DocumentCondition.description: none is leaderless only. absent requires no retained primary state; tombstones require version. version binds exact scope, schema, authority and complete primary state.

TransactionStatusResponse.description: committed embeds the original receipt; rejected embeds precondition_failed. pending/unknown/expired have outcome:null. Unknown and pending never prove abort. Original operation collections are reauthorized against the current key grant before disclosure. ObjectDurable outcomes require durable native receipt ancestry coverage.
